run_make_unicode_groups: run the script to generate C++ tables for Unicode Script and Category groups
run_MakeRanges: run MakeRanges to convert a list of codes into compact range pairs
run_PrintRanges: run PrintRanges to output a C++ static array of range structs
run_PrintGroup: run PrintGroup to generate C++ data structures for a Unicode group of codes
run_main: run main to read Unicode categories and scripts then emit unicode_groups.cc
